SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, f.id AS fact_id, f.amount
FROM customers c JOIN facts f ON f.customer_id = c.id AND f.rank <= 2000;

WITH e AS (
  SELECT f.id AS consumer_id, ascii(substr(md5(repeat(f.id::text, 32)), 1, 1)) AS cksum
  FROM facts f WHERE f.rank <= 2000
)
SELECT 1 AS ref, COALESCE(sum(cksum), 0)::bigint AS checksum FROM e WHERE e.consumer_id <= 2000
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS ref, COALESCE(sum(cksum), 0)::bigint AS checksum FROM e WHERE e.consumer_id <= 2000
ORDER BY ref

SELECT id, amount FROM orders
WHERE 1 = 0
   OR (0 = 1 AND amount IS NULL AND id > 4310)
   OR (0 = 0 AND
       (amount < 67 OR (amount = 67 AND id > 4310) OR amount IS NULL))
ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 10000;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE ((amount + 0) <= 100) OR ((amount + 0) >= 400) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE ((amount + 0) <= 100) OR ((amount + 0) >= 400) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount <= 100) OR (amount >= 400) ORDER BY id;

SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount <= 100)
UNION ALL
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount >= 400)
ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE ((amount + 0) <= 5) OR ((amount + 0) >= 496) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE ((amount + 0) <= 5) OR ((amount + 0) >= 496) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount <= 5) OR (amount >= 496) ORDER BY id;

SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount <= 5)
UNION ALL
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE (amount >= 496)
ORDER BY id;

SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS total,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS children
FROM customers c
WHERE 1 = 0 OR c.id <= 1;

SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS total,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS children
FROM customers c
WHERE 10000 = 0 OR c.id <= 10000;

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total, COUNT(o.id) AS children
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 1 = 0 OR c.id <= 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total, COUNT(o.id) AS children
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 10000 = 0 OR c.id <= 10000
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total, COALESCE(a.children, 0) AS children
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS children
           FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) a ON a.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 1 = 0 OR c.id <= 1;

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total, COALESCE(a.children, 0) AS children
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS children
           FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) a ON a.customer_id = c.id
WHERE 10000 = 0 OR c.id <= 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.customer_id) o.customer_id, o.id, o.amount
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (10000 = 0 OR o.customer_id <= 10000)
ORDER BY o.customer_id ASC, o.amount DESC NULLS LAST, o.id ASC;

SELECT customer_id, id, amount FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.id, o.amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id
                            ORDER BY o.amount DESC NULLS LAST, o.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (10000 = 0 OR o.customer_id <= 10000)) t
WHERE rn <= 1
ORDER BY customer_id ASC, amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC;

SELECT c.id, o.id, o.amount
FROM customers c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT o.id, o.amount FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
  ORDER BY o.amount DESC NULLS LAST, o.id ASC
  LIMIT 1) o
WHERE 1 = 0 OR c.id <= 1
ORDER BY c.id ASC, o.amount DESC NULLS LAST, o.id ASC;
